recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-17792; only broader future terminology policy work should revisit historical retirement/version metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-17792 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core TerminologyCapabilities. It requested retiring the confusing explicit/all CodeSearchSupport codes and replacing them with in-compose, in-expansion, and in-compose-or-expansion definitions for ValueSet code search support.
initial_application: Commit 301156f887, merged by 968d352ccc, applied FHIR-17792 by replacing explicit/all in the CodeSearchSupport code system, updating TerminologyCapabilities.codeSearch short text, and changing the example codeSearch value to in-compose-or-expansion. The value set includes the whole code-search-support code system, so it resolves to the current three-code set.
additional_context: The original Zulip thread confirms the compose-versus-expansion ambiguity. Vocab minutes on 2022-03-03 record the adjusted FHIR-17792 resolution and mention FHIR-36194 as a bounded search-page follow-up. Current source/fhir.ini lists TerminologyCapabilities as an active normative resource, and no later CodeSearchSupport Jira issue was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source contains the three approved concepts, the TerminologyCapabilities binding/short text, examples, and tests using the replacement code; stale explicit/all CodeSearchSupport values are absent from the authoritative code system, value set, and TerminologyCapabilities.codeSearch element.
